report_type.description: The field 'report_type' indicates the type of report ('report': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000088) generated by the EnzyWizard-Aaprops software.

amino_acid_residue_properties.description: The field 'amino_acid_residue_properties' indicates the amino acid residue properties ('amino acid residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) calculated from the protein structure ('protein structure': http://edamontology.org/data_1537).

residue_index.description: The field 'residue_index' indicates the index ('index': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25390) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_name.description: The field 'residue_name' indicates the name of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782), using one-letter code ('one-letter code': https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/AminoAcid/A2021.html) to represent the amino acid residue.

residue_name_one_hot_encoding.description: The field 'residue_name_one_hot_encoding' indicates the one-hot encoding ('one-hot encoding': https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/glossary#one-hot_encoding) of the residue name ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_chemical_classification.description: The field 'residue_chemical_classification' indicates the chemical classification ('classification': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25161) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_chemical_classification_multi_ho.description: The field 'residue_chemical_classification_multi_hot_encoding' indicates the multi-hot encoding ('multi-hot encoding': https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course/categorical-data/one-hot-encoding) of the chemical classification ('classification': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25161) of the amino acid residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_secondary_structure.description: The field 'residue_secondary_structure' indicates the secondary structure ('secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847) assigned to the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782), using DSSP secondary-structure codes ('DSSP': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html).

residue_secondary_structure_one_hot_enco.description: The field 'residue_secondary_structure_one_hot_encoding' indicates the one-hot encoding ('one-hot encoding': https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/glossary#one-hot_encoding) of the residue secondary structure ('secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

residue_relative_solvent_accessibility.description: The field 'residue_relative_solvent_accessibility' indicates the relative solvent accessibility ('solvent accessibility': http://edamontology.org/data_1542) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: dimensionless ('dimensionless': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS).

residue_backbone_phi_angle.description: The field 'residue_backbone_phi_angle' indicates the backbone phi torsion angle ('torsion angle': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/T06406) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) in the protein backbone ('protein backbone': http://edamontology.org/operation_1825). Unit: degrees (°) ('degree': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG).

residue_backbone_psi_angle.description: The field 'residue_backbone_psi_angle' indicates the backbone psi torsion angle ('torsion angle': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/T06406) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) in the protein backbone ('protein backbone': http://edamontology.org/operation_1825). Unit: degrees (°) ('degree': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG).

residue_net_charge.description: The field 'residue_net_charge' indicates the net electric charge ('net electric charge': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/N04111) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: dimensionless ('dimensionless': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS).

residue_pka.description: The field 'residue_pka' indicates the pKa value ('pKa': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/15441) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: dimensionless ('dimensionless': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS).

residue_volume.description: The field 'residue_volume' indicates the volume ('volume': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PATO_0000918) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: cubic angstroms (Å^3) ('cubic angstrom': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ANGSTROM3).

residue_hydrophobicity.description: The field 'residue_hydrophobicity' indicates the hydrophobicity ('hydrophobicity': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/HT06964) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: dimensionless ('dimensionless': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS).

residue_molecular_weight.description: The field 'residue_molecular_weight' indicates the molecular weight ('molecular weight': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/R05271) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: daltons (Da) ('dalton': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DA).

residue_isoelectric_point.description: The field 'residue_isoelectric_point' indicates the isoelectric point ('isoelectric point': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/I03275) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: dimensionless ('dimensionless': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS).

residue_alpha_carbon_coordinate.description: The field 'residue_alpha_carbon_coordinate' indicates the three-dimensional coordinate ('coordinate': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C44477) of the alpha carbon atom ('alpha carbon': https://www.rcsb.org/docs/general-help/glossary; 'atom': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHMO_0001075) in the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782). Unit: angstroms (Å) ('angstrom': http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ANGSTROM).

residue_properties_statistics.description: The field 'residue_properties_statistics' indicates the summary statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of residue properties ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_name_statistics.description: The field 'residue_name_statistics' indicates the statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of residue names ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

alanine_count.description: The field 'alanine_count' indicates the count of alanine ('alanine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_16977) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

cysteine_count.description: The field 'cysteine_count' indicates the count of cysteine ('cysteine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_15356) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

aspartic_acid_count.description: The field 'aspartic_acid_count' indicates the count of aspartic acid ('aspartic acid': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_22660) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

glutamic_acid_count.description: The field 'glutamic_acid_count' indicates the count of glutamic acid ('glutamic acid': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_18237) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

phenylalanine_count.description: The field 'phenylalanine_count' indicates the count of phenylalanine ('phenylalanine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_28044) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

glycine_count.description: The field 'glycine_count' indicates the count of glycine ('glycine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_15428) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

histidine_count.description: The field 'histidine_count' indicates the count of histidine ('histidine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_27570) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

isoleucine_count.description: The field 'isoleucine_count' indicates the count of isoleucine ('isoleucine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_24898) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

lysine_count.description: The field 'lysine_count' indicates the count of lysine ('lysine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_25094) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

leucine_count.description: The field 'leucine_count' indicates the count of leucine ('leucine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_25017) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

methionine_count.description: The field 'methionine_count' indicates the count of methionine ('methionine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_16811) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

asparagine_count.description: The field 'asparagine_count' indicates the count of asparagine ('asparagine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_22653) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

proline_count.description: The field 'proline_count' indicates the count of proline ('proline': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_17203) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

glutamine_count.description: The field 'glutamine_count' indicates the count of glutamine ('glutamine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_18050) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

arginine_count.description: The field 'arginine_count' indicates the count of arginine ('arginine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_29016) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

serine_count.description: The field 'serine_count' indicates the count of serine ('serine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_17822) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

threonine_count.description: The field 'threonine_count' indicates the count of threonine ('threonine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_16857) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

valine_count.description: The field 'valine_count' indicates the count of valine ('valine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_27266) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

tryptophan_count.description: The field 'tryptophan_count' indicates the count of tryptophan ('tryptophan': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_27897) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

tyrosine_count.description: The field 'tyrosine_count' indicates the count of tyrosine ('tyrosine': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_18186) residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_chemical_classification_statisti.description: The field 'residue_chemical_classification_statistics' indicates the statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of residue chemical classifications ('classification': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25161).

uncharged_polar_count.description: The field 'uncharged_polar_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the uncharged polar classification ('uncharged polar': https://www.imgt.org/IMGTeducation/Aide-memoire/_UK/aminoacids/IMGTclasses.html).

positively_charged_count.description: The field 'positively_charged_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the positively charged classification ('positively charged': https://www.imgt.org/IMGTeducation/Aide-memoire/_UK/aminoacids/IMGTclasses.html).

negatively_charged_count.description: The field 'negatively_charged_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the negatively charged classification ('negatively charged': https://www.imgt.org/IMGTeducation/Aide-memoire/_UK/aminoacids/IMGTclasses.html).

hydrophobic_count.description: The field 'hydrophobic_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the hydrophobic classification ('hydrophobic': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/HT06964).

aromatic_count.description: The field 'aromatic_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the aromatic classification ('aromatic': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/A00441).

aliphatic_count.description: The field 'aliphatic_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the aliphatic classification ('aliphatic': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/A00217).

heterocyclic_count.description: The field 'heterocyclic_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the heterocyclic classification ('heterocyclic': https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/H02798).

sulfur_containing_count.description: The field 'sulfur_containing_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to the sulfur-containing classification ('sulfur': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_26833).

residue_secondary_structure_statistics.description: The field 'residue_secondary_structure_statistics' indicates the statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of residue secondary structures ('secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

unassigned_count.description: The field 'unassigned_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) without assigned secondary structure ('secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

alpha_helix_count.description: The field 'alpha_helix_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to alpha-helix secondary structures ('alpha helix': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

beta_bridge_count.description: The field 'beta_bridge_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to beta-bridge secondary structures ('beta bridge': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

extended_strand_count.description: The field 'extended_strand_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to extended-strand secondary structures ('extended strand': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

three_ten_helix_count.description: The field 'three_ten_helix_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to 3-10 helix secondary structures ('3-10 helix': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

pi_helix_count.description: The field 'pi_helix_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to pi-helix secondary structures ('pi helix': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

turn_count.description: The field 'turn_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to turn secondary structures ('turn': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).

bend_count.description: The field 'bend_count' indicates the count of residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) assigned to bend secondary structures ('bend': https://manual.gromacs.org/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dssp.html; 'secondary structure': http://edamontology.org/operation_1847).
